example.name: File return values
example.description:
Similar to just-in-time directories, Dagger Functions can produce just-in-time files by returning the `File` type.
Just-in-time files might be produced by a Dagger Function that:
- Builds language-specific binaries - Combines multiple input files into a single output file, such as a composite video or a compressed archive
